document.title: FHA Single Family Loan Performance Trends (Credit Risk Report)
document.publisher: U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development, Office of Housing, Federal Housing Administration
document.exclusions: FHA-insured single-family forward mortgages in active insurance at month end; rates are not seasonally adjusted (the report also prints a seasonally adjusted block, which is not restated here)

level: 2 — attested restatement of an official publication; not computed by FinanceRateCalc
not_comparable_with: HMDA denial rates (those describe applications; this describes loans already insured)
delinquency rates for all US mortgages or for other programs
the seasonally adjusted series printed in the same table
the FHA production report's endorsement counts (new loans in a month, not loans outstanding)
does_not_establish: the delinquency risk of any one borrower or loan
a foreclosure completion or loss rate
that the figure has not been revised in a later edition (check the latest report)
quoting_rule: Keep the publisher, the edition, the month and 'not seasonally adjusted' with the figure. It is a share of FHA-insured loans outstanding at month end: do not present it as a share of applications, of all US mortgages, or as one borrower's risk.

prior_edition_check.note: Only changed figures and the receipted month are listed; 'compared' and 'changed' count all of them. The table restates every month it lists; each is compared with the same month as printed in the most recent earlier edition on file. A difference is a source revision, recorded here and, where the month has a receipt, written into that edition's file as revised_in/revised_to.
